arguments.description: Search prior logs for olean production commands
arguments.command:
cd D:\lean
Select-String -Path tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\logs\*.log -Pattern "olean" -List | Select-Object -First 5 | Out-String -Width 250
Select-String -Path coord\reports\*.md, coord\STATE.md, AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Pattern "olean" | Select-Object -First 20 | Out-String -Width 250
